title: Support Google Drive remote corpus ingestion for residio corpus
description: Add google-drive remote corpus source support, validate nested-folder ingest using the residio Drive folder, and run topic/Markov(HMM) analysis workflows on the ingested corpus.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implemented Google Drive remote source support end-to-end (new kind: google-drive, folder_url support, adapter, CLI wiring, collection wiring, unit+BDD coverage including nested/prefix scenarios). Added robust Drive behavior: gdown folder listing with remaining_ok + direct per-file streaming download (fallback to gdown download), and prefix-aware download filtering. Validated with tests (pytest tests/test_remote_source_coverage.py + remote source Behave features). Real residio run completed with scoped prefix recordings_10 (1)/: source pull listed/downloaded 10 WAV items, then extraction succeeded via stt-faster-whisper tiny (snapshot ef3a34c8...), topic modeling succeeded (snapshot 2d09e3d1..., docs=10, topics=1), and Markov/HMM analysis succeeded (snapshot 8d98ac63..., items=10, segments=1992, states=5, transitions=18).

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Continuing while user is away: executing full residio corpus run without prefix, then full extraction and analysis reruns. Will record resulting artifact snapshots and metrics.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Investigation note: extraction is already parallel at item level via ThreadPoolExecutor, but heartbeat currently shows only one active_item so it appears serial. Throughput bottleneck identified in STT path: FasterWhisper extractor creates WhisperModel inside each item call, and get_extractor constructs extractor instances repeatedly. I am applying a performance patch next to cache model/extractor initialization for this workload.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Progress update (Mar 4, 2026 19:31 ET): extraction crossed 150 milestone and is now at 157/245 processed; 138 extracted, 12 skipped, 0 errored. Also implemented perf fixes for future runs: (1) extractor registry now instantiates only the requested extractor instead of constructing all extractors on every call; (2) faster-whisper model loading is now cached by model/device/compute_type to avoid re-initializing per item.
